answer: Standing lapses unless 4 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in reef and tundra lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those since the attesters must be independent on the vertex graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 560 impostors cost 1297 times the honest price and take 9 times as long to clear. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
